text:
lina: FYI PR #5982 has the migration guide + ruby + go SDK snippets. I left a few inline notes but holding for a full pass + preview before any merge. Looking for reviewers and a merge slot.

ben: I can take it after lunch. Anything specific to watch for?

lina: Thanks — please focus on the migration checklist and the Ruby snippet; we've recently standardized on 'private deployment' and 'Redwood Private' rather than older terms. Also avoid second-person phrasing in the overview paragraph.

oliver: tagging in for tone/voice. Quick reminder: docs directive is to use active, concise sentences. Replace marketing copy like 'best-in-class' with factual descriptions.

maya: small heads-up on the Go snippet: we now surface `client.Responses.Create` in the SDK, so the examples should use that. Also ensure code blocks include minimal imports so they run in the playground.

alex: CI/preview schedule: there's a 14:00 PT merge window tomorrow. If preview passes and two reviewers approve (one wording, one tech), we can merge in that window.

docs-bot: preview job #942 queued (branch: docs/pr-5982). Detailed report will post here when ready.

ben: I'll verify links and headings while the preview runs. Lina, I found one broken reference to /guides/old-migration — should be /migration/v2.

lina: good catch, fixing that now. Also swapping 'on-prem' -> 'private deployment' across the doc.

docs-bot: preview job #943 started. Linting + linkcheck + sample run.

oliver: for tone, I suggested rephrasing the intro to three bullets: what changed, step-by-step migration, minimal runnable example. Drop the 'we recommend' phrasing.

maya: pushed a tiny patch to the go snippet to use Responses.Create and include fmt import.

ben: preview job #943 report: 1 warning (styling), 0 errors. Warning: heading H3 not sentence-case in one place.

lina: addressing the H3 case now; also removed a stray marketing sentence. Re-pushing.

docs-bot: preview job #944 started.

alex: if #944 passes, please add reviewers approvals and I'll queue for the 14:00 PT slot. We need both tech and voice sign-off.

oliver: reviewing now. Two tiny tone nits, will approve after I push them.

maya: verified the Ruby code sample runs locally; updated gem version pin to match SDK.

docs-bot: preview job #944 succeeded. Linkcheck: OK. Lint: OK. Sample-run: OK.

oliver: did the tone pass, approved. :white_check_mark:

ben: technical review done, approved. :thumbsup:

alex: great. Scheduling merge for 14:05 PT tomorrow. Lina, please merge in the slot unless any last-minute blocks.

lina: will do. Tag me if anything pops up. Thanks everyone.

before-merge-check: ben: just a final smoke — will watch the preview after merge for missing static asset 404s (common after redirects).

docs-bot: deploy preview will be available in ~2m after merge.

lina: merged at 14:05 PT. Thanks all — monitoring the site now.

ben: live check passing on /migration/v2, examples render correctly. No 404s observed.

oliver: LGTM on live site. Good catch on the wording changes — feels tighter.

maya: happy path verified for Ruby and Go snippets.

docs-bot: live site monitoring: no new errors in the last 30m.
